snippet.title: Corner Wars (Tower Defense) Trailer
snippet.description:
Corner Wars is a modern tower defense game that runs discreetly in the corner of your screen. Build your defenses, send creeps against your opponents, and create your own deck. Play solo or multiplayer, upgrade cards, and compete for the top spots on the leaderboards.

Free demo on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170020/Corner_Wars/
